title: Historical dataset-v2 decisions
purpose: Retain failed corpus decisions without presenting them as current Wikimedia readiness.
summary: Historical audited token snapshots failed their quality gates. These results are preserved and do not overturn the later separately reviewed Wikimedia source decision.
methodology: Keep native-token audits, split/protection checks and quality decisions separate.
Full original source-specific results and remediation chronology are retained in the archive.
results: Both extended panels also failed. A separate semantic-admission census is preprocessing evidence, not a fresh passing approval panel.
limitations: Historical snapshot availability differs after previously authorized storage cleanup; retained manifests and hashes describe their capture time.
Token count and completed assessments do not confer admission or training authorization.
next_actions: Use the current source readiness report for the selected language continuation; do not rebuild these candidates during cleanup.
